descriptionByLocale.en:
Requirements
• 3-year vocational apprenticeship with a federal certificate of ability or general education degree (FMS or Matura) and at least 1-year professional experience

• Multicheck (Health HF), not older than 2 years

• Driving licence category, C1/D1 with code 121 or 122

• Minimum age 21 years | We offer: you:

• an exciting and varied education in the mountain region Graubünden with the largest catchment area of the canton and thus long transport routes

• practical training at the SIRMED Higher School of Applied Sciences in Nottwil

• Working independently and independently in your area of competence

• continuous monitoring and support throughout the training

• An attractive service design

• a high leisure value in the touristy very attractive environment.

Do you feel addressed and would you like to become part of our foundation?
Then apply to us.
